suggestions.roleTitleVi: Kỹ thuật viên Tự động hóa & Robot Công nghiệp
suggestions.reasoning: As noted by RMIT University Vietnam, while Vietnam ranks high in STEM graduates, there is a significant gap in applied technical skills required for advanced manufacturing. Automation systems and robotics rely heavily on physical installation, mechanical adjustments, and electrical safety—areas where physical presence and hands-on diagnosis cannot be replaced by generative AI. As highlighted by the International Labour Organization (ILO), most jobs are complemented rather than substituted, making technical maintenance roles highly resilient when enhanced with programming skills.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: With 10 years of solid electrical maintenance experience, a strong logic-based troubleshooting mindset, and comfort with shift work in Hai Phong's industrial zones, you are ideally positioned to step up into automation. Your existing ability to read electrical drawings and maintain circuits gives you a massive operational head start.
